title: High-Throughput Amplification-Based Analysis of DNA Samples via Nanopore Sequencing
author: Jordan P Cuff
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bw2cpgaw
materials: LongAmp Hot Start Taq 2X Master Mix

steps.title: Extract and purify DNA
steps.instruction: Extract and purify DNA using a method appropriate for the sample type, desired fragment length, and minimizing contaminants/inhibitors.

steps.title: Quantify DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a Qubit high‑sensitivity or broad‑range dsDNA assay (optional).

steps.title: Set up LongAmp PCR with barcode
steps.instruction: In a tube combine 10 µL adapter‑ligated DNA, 14 µL nuclease‑free water, 1 µL barcode primer (BC01‑96), and 25 µL 2× LongAmp Hot Start Taq Master Mix to a total volume of 50 µL.

steps.title: Prepare DNA repair and end‑prep mix
steps.instruction: Mix in order: 47 µL DNA, 1 µL DNA CS1, 3.5 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Buffer, 2 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Mix, 3.5 µL Ultra II End‑prep reaction buffer, 3 µL Ultra II End‑prep enzyme mix. Total 60 µL.

steps.title: Set up Ultra II End‑Prep reaction
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 mL tube add 12.5 µL DNA (in nuclease‑free water), 1.75 µL Ultra II End‑Prep Reaction Buffer, and 0.75 µL Ultra II End‑Prep Enzyme Mix. Total 15 µL.

steps.title: Ligate barcode adapters
steps.instruction: Add to the 15 µL end‑prepped DNA 8 µL barcode adapter (BCA) and 10 µL Blunt‑TA Ligase Master Mix. Mix gently and incubate as described in the thermal incubation step.

steps.title: Clean ligated DNA with 0.4X AMPure
steps.instruction: Add 13.2 µL AMPure beads (0.4× volume) to the ligation product, mix, incubate, place on magnet, wash twice with 200 µL 70 % ethanol, resuspend in 26 µL nuclease‑free water, leaving 1 µL on the beads.

steps.title: Thermal incubation of ligation
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction with the following program: 95 °C 3 min; 195 °C 0:15 min; 1862 °C 0:15 min; 65 °C 16:40 min; 65 °C 6 min; 14 °C hold. Extension time ≈50 s per kbp (e.g., 16:40 for ~20 kbp).

steps.title: Measure DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Quantify the cleaned DNA using Qubit high‑sensitivity or broad‑range dsDNA assay (or similar).

steps.title: Pool barcoded samples equimolarly
steps.instruction: Calculate volumes to add for each sample by dividing its concentration by the highest concentration, then combine to achieve approximate equimolarity.

steps.title: Clean pooled DNA with 1X AMPure
steps.instruction: Add 1× AMPure beads to the pooled sample, mix, place on magnet, wash twice with 200 µL 70 % ethanol, resuspend in 50 µL nuclease‑free water, retain 48 µL (leave 2 µL on beads) and use 1 µL for concentration measurement.

steps.title: Optional second AMPure clean
steps.instruction: If desired, clean the sample again with 1× AMPure beads, wash twice with 200 µL 70 % ethanol, resuspend in 61 µL nuclease‑free water, keep 60 µL for downstream use (leave 1 µL on beads). Do not incubate longer than 10 min after the next step if skipped.

steps.title: Prepare final ligation reaction
steps.instruction: Combine 60 µL DNA, 5 µL Adapter Mix AMX, 25 µL Ligation Buffer LNB (or T4 buffer), and 10 µL NEBNext Quick T4 DNA Ligase. Total volume 100 µL.

steps.title: Final bead clean and elution
steps.instruction: Clean the ligation product with 1× AMPure beads, washing twice with either LFB (for fragments ≥3 kb) or SFB (for <3 kb). Resuspend beads in 17 µL elution buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 + 50 mM NaCl), leave 1 µL on beads, and measure 1 µL concentration. Target input: 5‑50 fmol (R9.4.1), 25‑75 fmol (R10.3), 3‑20 fmol (flongle).

steps.title: Prepare and load flow cell
steps.instruction: Allow flow cell to equilibrate to room temperature for 20‑30 min, insert into MinION, check active pores, remove <20 µL yellow buffer to purge air, thaw SQB, LB, FLT, and FB at room temperature, vortex all but FLT briefly and spin down. Add 30 µL FLT to FB tube, mix, add 800 µL to flow cell via priming port. Prepare loading mix: 25.5 µL Loading Beads (LB), 34 µL Sequencing Buffer (SQB), 4.5 µL nuclease‑free water, 11 µL DNA library (total 75 µL). Gently flick/invert, load 75 µL dropwise through SpotON port, then start sequencing with default 24‑hour settings.

steps.title: Optional flongle sequencing preparation
steps.instruction: If using a flongle, let it reach room temperature 20‑30 min, insert into MinION, check pores, ensure no air bubbles, thaw SQB, LB, FLT, FB, vortex all but FLT, spin down. Prepare flush solution: 3 µL FLT + 117 µL FB (total 120 µL); add 100 µL to flongle via priming port. Prepare loading mix: 10 µL LB, 15 µL SQB, 5 µL DNA library (total 30 µL). Flick/invert, load 30 µL via priming port, and sequence for 24 h.

steps.title: Optional size‑selection bead clean
steps.instruction: If targeting long fragments, perform a 0.4× SPRI‑Select bead clean: add 0.4× bead volume to sample, wash twice with 200 µL 70 % ethanol, elute into 12.5 µL nuclease‑free water (see bead‑clean steps for details).

steps.title: Incubate samples (protocol A)
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature (~20 °C) for 20 min, then at 70 °C for 10 min, then on ice (4 °C) for 1 min.

steps.title: Incubate samples (protocol B)
steps.instruction: Incubate at 25 °C for 10 min, then at 65 °C for 5 min, then at 4 °C for 1 min.

steps.title: Incubate samples (protocol C)
steps.instruction: Incubate at 20 °C for 5 min, then at 65 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Incubate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature (~20 °C) for 10 min.

steps.title: Add beads for clean
steps.instruction: Add the calculated volume of beads (e.g., 0.4× of 33 µL sample = 13.2 µL bead solution), mix by gentle flicking or pipetting.

steps.title: Incubate bead binding
steps.instruction: Incubate the bead‑DNA mixture for 5 min (or at least 10 min if not physically mixed).

steps.title: Prepare cleaning solution
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh 70 % ethanol or thaw LFB/SFB as appropriate.

steps.title: Magnet separation
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack for 5 min to separate beads.

steps.title: Wash beads
steps.instruction: While on the magnet, pipette off supernatant and wash beads with 200 µL cleaning solution (70 % ethanol or LFB/SFB) without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Second wash
steps.instruction: Incubate 30 s, remove ethanol, then repeat wash with another 200 µL cleaning solution.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Pipette off residual cleaning solution, briefly spin down, keep tube on magnet, and air‑dry beads for ~30‑120 s until matte.

steps.title: Resuspend beads
steps.instruction: Add the required resuspension volume (e.g., 25 µL nuclease‑free water), mix, and incubate 5 min.

steps.title: Final bead pelleting
steps.instruction: Place tube on magnet until solution is clear and colourless, confirming beads are fully separated.

steps.title: Collect cleaned DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the desired volume of resuspended DNA to a new tube, retaining it for downstream steps.
